question: what actually distinguishes two cell lines - potency of the compounds (additive main effects) or the interaction residual?
synthesis: the ~70% potency share ties the programme together: cross-cell prediction works because potency orderings correlate (C2 0.816); own data buys little because ~37 potency parameters need many measurements (C18, C20); the 30% interaction is the tail and, though conserved at 0.60 (C12, C24), does not robustly improve ranking (C24)
capacity_caveat: the share mixes model capacity with data structure - 37 free parameters on 351 observations necessarily absorb part of the between-cell difference, so 0.70 means 'the share a 37-parameter potency model explains', not a biological partition
